_meta.title: FIXEO Peinture Human Price Decision Freeze
_meta.disclaimer: Prix indicatif FIXEO — tarif réel confirmé avec l'artisan avant intervention.

approved_services.label: Minimum Painting Project
approved_services.anti_double_charge_rule: The 800 MAD minimum is a FLOOR, not additive. It applies only when the m²-based result falls below 800 MAD. It must never be added ON TOP of a price that already exceeds 800 MAD.
scope_inclusions: Small touch-up up to approximately 10m² painted surface
approved_services.escape_rule: If painted surface exceeds approximately 10m², convert to PEIN-002 or PEIN-003 per-m² pricing

approved_services.label: Interior Wall — Labour Only (client supplies paint)
approved_services.label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur — main d'œuvre seule (peinture client)
approved_services.minimum_project_integration: 800 MAD minimum applies (PEIN-001 floor). Formula: max(800, 35 × m²). Anti-double-charge: minimum is not additive.
approved_services.primer_policy: APPLIED_WHERE_OBJECTIVELY_REQUIRED. Material: client-supplied or separately agreed and disclosed.
approved_services.coat_doctrine: 2 finish coats standard. Primer applied where objectively required by substrate, product, or significant colour coverage requirement. Dark-to-light transition may require 3rd coat — artisan identifies before starting, explains scope consequence, obtains client approval before proceeding.

included_minor_prep_at_no_extra_charge: Small nail holes (up to 5 per wall)
ready_to_paint_contract.objective_escape_threshold: Preparation time materially exceeding the READY_TO_PAINT allowance → escape to PEIN-005 or declare HORS PÉRIMÈTRE. No subjective artisan-only surcharge permitted.

scope_inclusions: Very small nail-hole filling / fine crack touch-up within READY_TO_PAINT contract
Application of 2 finish coats of client-supplied paint
complexity_escape_rules: Dark-to-light colour change → 3rd coat discussion before work starts

approved_services.label: Interior Wall — Labour + Standard Paint Included
approved_services.label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur — main d'œuvre + peinture standard incluse
approved_services.human_adjustment_reason: V0.2 recommended 60 MAD/m² but its own material-economic model showed only ~9.8 MAD/m² gross margin before commission. Human raised to 65 MAD/m² to protect artisan economics while remaining inside the external 45–80 MAD/m² market range.
approved_services.minimum_project_integration: 800 MAD minimum applies. Formula: max(800, 65 × m²).

paint_specification.finish: Mate or satiné — client chooses within standard range
paint_specification.colour: Standard palette. Specialty tinting/mixing: disclosed separately if additional cost.

approved_services.coat_doctrine: Same as PEIN-002. 2 finish coats standard. Dark-to-light → 3 coats, client approval before proceeding.
scope_exclusions: Enduit de lissage (quoted separately via PEIN-008 if needed)

economic_validation_at_65.assessment: IMPROVED. At 65 MAD/m², artisan effective daily net-labour (after commission and material) = 2403 MAD/day vs 1785 MAD/day for PEIN-002 labour-only. The 255 MAD/day improvement at 65 vs 60 resolves the weak margin identified in V0.2.
economic_validation_at_65.label: FIXEO_POLICY_ESTIMATE

approved_services.label: Ceiling — Standard Repaint
approved_services.pricing_formula: FINAL_PRICE = max(800, 45 × CEILING_M2). Ceiling m² = room floor area.
approved_services.measurement_note: CEILING_M2 equals the floor area of the room. Ceiling m² ≠ floor area of apartment. Painter measures room by room.
scope_inclusions: Local enduit where minor and required
scope_exclusions: Major enduit de lissage (more than minor local application)
complexity_escape_rules: Active moisture → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE — resolve source first (Plomberie/Toiture)
Ceiling height >3m → scaffolding surcharge or quote
Extensive enduit required → PEIN-008 add-on + reassessment

approved_services.label: Interior Wall — Labour + Standard Paint + Minor Preparation
approved_services.label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur avec préparation légère

included_at_no_extra_charge: Rebouchage of holes up to approximately 3cm diameter
Local filler on cracks up to 3mm width, ≤50cm length
Local enduit application on up to approximately 20% of wall surface
Local peeling treatment (up to minor threshold)
excluded_escape_to_quote_or_hors_perimet: More than approximately 20% of surface requires enduit
Cracks requiring V-cut or structural filler
minor_preparation_contract.objective_note: The approximately 20% enduit threshold is objective. If artisan assesses that more than 20% of the surface requires enduit during preparation, artisan must STOP, notify FIXEO, and request updated scope/quote before proceeding.

approved_services.human_adjustment: NONE — confirmed all-in 75 MAD as recommended

approved_services.label: Enduit de Lissage — Preparation Add-On
approved_services.estimator_guidance: NOT recommended as a standalone headline service in the estimator. To be offered as an add-on when PEIN-002, PEIN-003, or PEIN-004 surfaces require preparation beyond their included scope.
approved_services.pricing_formula: ADD_ON_PRICE = 25 × PAINTED_SURFACE_M2. Subject to PEIN-001 minimum only if used as a standalone booking (not typical use).
scope_inclusions: Up to 2 standard passes of enduit de lissage
Surface left smooth and ready for primer and paint
approved_services.escape_rule: Substrate requires >5mm fill or structural repair → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE Maçonnerie
approved_services.economic_note: Standalone: 25 MAD/m² × 35m²/day = 875 MAD/day gross → below target threshold as standalone. Confirmed as add-on only.

deferred_services.label: Full Standard Room (walls + ceiling)
deferred_services.deferred_reason: The V0.2 room-package recommendation at 1,800 MAD creates a material economic inconsistency. A standard room package at 1,800 MAD can be far below the equivalent price generated by the approved painted-surface contracts (equivalent at 60 MAD/m² all-in for ~75m² painted = ~4,500 MAD). The room architecture risks: underpricing large rooms, hidden surface assumptions, client confusion, and arbitrage between room and m² pricing. For V1: use painted-surface calculation model instead. A future room package may be reopened only after: explicit room-size taxonomy, measured FIXEO missions, clear surface ceiling, minimum transaction sample.

deferred_services.label: Full Apartment Repaint Package
deferred_services.deferred_reason: Too many variables (condition, size, paint quality). Use per-m² services instead.

deferred_services.label: Interior Door Painting
deferred_services.deferred_reason: Insufficient Moroccan evidence. Defer to V2.

deferred_services.label: Decorative Finishes (tadelakt, stucco, béton ciré)
deferred_services.deferred_reason: Artisan-skill dependent. 80–600 DH/m² range not standardizable.

deferred_services.label: Exterior Facade
deferred_services.deferred_reason: Scaffolding, height, access variables. Cannot be standardized.

deferred_services.label: Heavy Wall Repair / Moisture / Structural
deferred_services.deferred_reason: Always requires site assessment. May route to Maçonnerie.

painted_surface_doctrine.definition: Wall pricing = actual painted wall surface (perimeter × height − openings). Ceiling pricing = ceiling area = room floor area. NEVER floor area of property.

floor_area_conversion.note: No formula such as painted_surface = floor_area × fixed_multiplier may become canonical in this phase.

frozen_policies.coat_doctrine: 2 finish coats standard. Primer where objectively required. Dark-to-light → possible 3rd coat — identify before work, explain, obtain client approval before proceeding.
frozen_policies.minimum_anti_double_charge: FINAL = max(800, m² × rate). Never: 800 + (m² × rate).

moisture_mold_doctrine.rule: HORS PÉRIMÈTRE PEINTURE if active moisture detected
moisture_mold_doctrine.anti_humidity_paint: Preventive only on resolved moisture. Not a substitute for source treatment.
